title: U.S. House · Texas's 18th District
area: Central Houston and parts of Harris County.

context.text: Christian Menefee led the initial round of a special election on November 4, 2025 and won the special election runoff over Amanda Edwards on January 31, 2026, to fill the seat after Rep. Sylvester Turner died in March 2025. For the 2026 general election, Menefee defeated fellow incumbent U.S. Rep. Al Green in a May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff, 69.3% to 30.7%, after the two topped a crowded March 3, 2026 primary field. Ronald Whitfield defeated Elizabeth Vences, 55.1%-44.9%, in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.

candidates.name: Christian Menefee
candidates.currentRole: U.S. Representative (since 2026); previously Harris County Attorney (2021–2025)

positions.summary: His campaign website says he will fight to raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour.

positions.summary: His campaign website says he will fight for Medicare for All and for expanding Medicare and strengthening Medicaid.
positions.quote: And he will fight for Medicare for All.

positions.summary: His campaign website says he will work to fix the tax code so billionaires and large corporations pay their fair share.
positions.quote: He’ll also work to fix the tax code so that billionaires and large corporations pay their fair share

positions.quote: In Congress, Christian will fight to restore abortion rights, defend contraception and IVF, and block a national abortion ban.

positions.summary: His campaign website says he will fight to ban assault weapons, close background check loopholes and limit high-capacity magazines.
positions.quote: In Congress, Christian will fight to ban assault weapons, close background check loopholes, and limit high-capacity magazines.

record.text: Defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Al Green in the May 26, 2026 Democratic primary runoff for this seat, 69.3% to 30.7%.
